title: Datology Launches Curation Studio for Frontier Data Curation
summary:
Machine learning teams can now optimize the volume and quality of the information used to build their own AI models. Datology released terms of access for Curation Studio, a tool that provides customizable frontier data curation to ensure that data quality acts as the "ultimate compute multiplier" for model performance.

The studio is designed to be accessible to any team training its own models to simplify the process of selecting high-quality training data. The company made the tool available starting October 9.
